items.text: Find the host application form (step 2) and its save request
Trace the server save endpoint and find why it 500s
Reproduce against a running server: local save works, so the difference is production
Root cause: production Postgres Prisma schema lacks the four payout fields the save writes
Add the four payout fields to schema.postgresql.prisma
Add a schema-parity test so the two schemas cannot drift again (proved it fails on the old schema)
Verify: prisma validate, server typecheck, test suite, lint, build, live save round trip
Commit the schema fix and the new test, then push
